_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Tyrell Jackson
about_me: I'm Tyrell, co-founder of CodeBridge, a free after-school coding program for teens in Southwest Detroit. We serve 80 students. I need volunteer mentors who can come in weekly and a funder for laptops.
goals: Recruit ten weekly volunteer mentors for CodeBridge

debriefs.text: Rosa Martinez, my co-founder and a community organizer in Southwest Detroit, handles families and space. She said the church hall is ours through June.
Met Zoe Park, president of Women in Computing at Michigan. She offered to organize a monthly mentor carpool from Ann Arbor.
Talked to Kofi Asante, founder of TutorLoop, an edtech startup. He wants to pilot his tutoring app with our students and offered free licenses.
Sam Delaney from engineering alumni relations said alumni in Detroit want volunteer opportunities. I promised to send him a one-page description.

card.headline: Co-founder, CodeBridge
card.about: Free coding program for 80 Detroit teens.

request.need: Volunteers who can mentor teens in coding one evening a week in Detroit
